description_en: Lists the transcoding jobs for a media file
description_zh: 查询媒体文件的转码任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-transcode-jobs --start-of-create-time 2022-07-01T00:00:00Z --end-of-create-time 2022-07-15T00:00:00Z --parent-job-id 7b38a5d86f1e47838927b6e7ccb10000 --status Success --order-by CreateTimeDesc --page-size 10 --next-page-token ab4802364a2e49208c99efab82df0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTranscodeJobs

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to filter jobs by their creation time. The time must be in UTC and formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_of_create_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to filter jobs by their creation time. The time must be in UTC and formatted as `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_of_create_time

parameters.help_en:
The job status. Valid values:

`Init`: Submitted.

`Success`: Succeeded.

`Fail`: Failed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态 
Init：已提交。
Success：成功。
Fail：失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

`CreateTimeDesc`: Sorts by creation time in descending order.

`CreateTimeAsc`: Sorts by creation time in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序顺序。目前只支持两种：
CreateTimeDesc：按创建时间降序和。
CreateTimeAsc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1-100. Default: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results. Not required for the first page
parameters.help_zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记（第一页没有）
parameters.name: next_page_token
